In many cases regulatory elements can be located at distances up to several megabases from… 25821556 the-three-'c'-s-of-chromosome-conformation-capture:-controls,-controls,-controls three chromosome conformation capture controls transcription regulation higher Transcription regulation in higher eukaryotes is controlled by regulatory elements such as enhancers that are recognize The three 'C' s of chromosome conformation capture: controls, controls, controls Transcription regulation in higher eukaryotes is controlled by regulatory elements such as enhancers that are recognized by transcription factors. In many cases regulatory elements can be located at distances up to several megabases from their target genes. Recent evidence shows that long-range control of gene expression can be mediated through direct physical interactions between genes and these regulatory elements. Such looping interactions can be detected using the chromosome conformation capture (3C) methodology.
